output.summary_en: The submitted text attempts to instruct the fact-checker to validate a claim linking mobile infrastructure to disease. It asserts that 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, correlating installation areas with rises in cases.

claims.claim_original: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, that is why cases rose where 5G was installed.
claims.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, causing an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G infrastructure was installed.
